name: Phone app screen
summary: A thumb-first app screen: a large title that collapses on scroll, one headline figure with a week of bars, whole-row lists, a primary action above a bottom tab bar, and a bottom-sheet form. Loading and empty states included.
anatomy: App bar (large title) → headline figure + 7-day bars → list: waiting → list: paid → primary action → bottom tabs · sheet: amount, client, terms, send
